config.title: Core Web Vitals (phone)
config.description: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP, how long the main content takes to appear), Interaction to Next Paint (INP, how quickly the page responds to taps and clicks) and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS, how much the page jumps around) for the page on phone. Each value is what 3 in 4 visits met or beat over the last 28 days, colored by its rating.

config.title: Core Web Vitals (desktop)
config.description: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP, how long the main content takes to appear), Interaction to Next Paint (INP, how quickly the page responds to taps and clicks) and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS, how much the page jumps around) for the page on desktop. Each value is what 3 in 4 visits met or beat over the last 28 days, colored by its rating.

config.title: Page vs whole site
config.description: Each metric for this page against the whole site on all devices over the last 28 days, using the value 3 in 4 visits met or beat. Lower is better, so Worse means this page is slower or less stable than the site.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
SELECT
  page.metric,
  CASE WHEN page.metric = 'CLS' THEN printf('%.2f', page.p75) WHEN page.p75 >= 1000 THEN printf('%.2f s', page.p75 / 1000) ELSE printf('%d ms', CAST(round(page.p75) AS BIGINT)) END AS pageP75,
  CASE WHEN site.metric = 'CLS' THEN printf('%.2f', site.p75) WHEN site.p75 >= 1000 THEN printf('%.2f s', site.p75 / 1000) ELSE printf('%d ms', CAST(round(site.p75) AS BIGINT)) END AS siteP75,
  CASE page.rating WHEN 'success' THEN 'Good' WHEN 'warning' THEN 'Needs improvement' ELSE 'Poor' END AS pageRating,
  CASE site.rating WHEN 'success' THEN 'Good' WHEN 'warning' THEN 'Needs improvement' ELSE 'Poor' END AS siteRating,
  CASE
    WHEN round(page.p75, 2) < round(site.p75, 2) THEN 'Better'
    WHEN round(page.p75, 2) > round(site.p75, 2) THEN 'Worse'
    ELSE 'Same'
  END AS comparison
FROM page
JOIN site ON page.metric = site.metric
ORDER BY CASE page.metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

config.title: Distribution (phone)
config.description: How many visits to the page on phone had a good, needs improvement or poor experience of each metric over the last 28 days. A metric passes when the good share is 75% or more.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
SELECT metric, bucket, share
FROM (
  SELECT metric, CASE metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS metricOrder, 1 AS bucketOrder, 'Good' AS bucket, CAST(good AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM vitals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT metric, CASE metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS metricOrder, 2 AS bucketOrder, 'Needs improvement' AS bucket, CAST(needsImprovement AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM vitals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT metric, CASE metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS metricOrder, 3 AS bucketOrder, 'Poor' AS bucket, CAST(poor AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM vitals
)
ORDER BY metricOrder, bucketOrder

config.title: Distribution (desktop)
config.description: How many visits to the page on desktop had a good, needs improvement or poor experience of each metric over the last 28 days. A metric passes when the good share is 75% or more.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
SELECT metric, bucket, share
FROM (
  SELECT metric, CASE metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS metricOrder, 1 AS bucketOrder, 'Good' AS bucket, CAST(good AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM vitals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT metric, CASE metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS metricOrder, 2 AS bucketOrder, 'Needs improvement' AS bucket, CAST(needsImprovement AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM vitals
  UNION ALL
  SELECT metric, CASE metric WHEN 'LCP' THEN 1 WHEN 'INP' THEN 2 WHEN 'CLS' THEN 3 WHEN 'FCP' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS metricOrder, 3 AS bucketOrder, 'Poor' AS bucket, CAST(poor AS DOUBLE) AS share FROM vitals
)
ORDER BY metricOrder, bucketOrder

config.title: LCP breakdown
config.description: How long each stage of loading the main image takes for the page on all devices, in load order (each is its own 3 in 4 visits value, so they do not add up to LCP). Large TTFB: check the server, CDN and caching; large load delay: preload the image and do not lazy-load it; large load time: compress, resize or use modern formats; large render delay: cut render-blocking scripts and styles.

config.title: LCP element
config.description: Whether the main content (the largest element on screen) was an image or text, as a share of visits to the page over the last 28 days.

config.title: LCP trend
config.description: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP, how long the main content takes to appear) for the page against its whole site on phone, as met or beaten by 3 in 4 visits in the 28 days ending each week. The lines mark the good and poor thresholds.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
SELECT periodEnd, 'Page' AS series, p75 FROM page WHERE metric = 'LCP'
UNION ALL
SELECT periodEnd, 'Whole site' AS series, p75 FROM site WHERE metric = 'LCP'
ORDER BY periodEnd, series

config.title: INP trend
config.description: Interaction to Next Paint (INP, how quickly the page responds to taps and clicks) for the page against its whole site on phone, as met or beaten by 3 in 4 visits in the 28 days ending each week. To improve it, break up long JavaScript tasks and trim third-party scripts.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
SELECT periodEnd, 'Page' AS series, p75 FROM page WHERE metric = 'INP'
UNION ALL
SELECT periodEnd, 'Whole site' AS series, p75 FROM site WHERE metric = 'INP'
ORDER BY periodEnd, series

config.title: CLS trend
config.description: Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS, how much the page jumps around while loading) for the page against its whole site on phone, as met or beaten by 3 in 4 visits in the 28 days ending each week. To improve it, reserve space for images, ads and embeds.

dataSourceConfig.sql:
SELECT periodEnd, 'Page' AS series, p75 FROM page WHERE metric = 'CLS'
UNION ALL
SELECT periodEnd, 'Whole site' AS series, p75 FROM site WHERE metric = 'CLS'
ORDER BY periodEnd, series
